result: Bound static provider value on the packaged post-DDR map path: KernelSize=0x10000000 (256 MiB), KernelBaseAddr=0xc7800000. Not an observed variable or a minimum over arbitrary handoffs. The SEC implementation of the QcomBds lookup is present; it is not an unresolved protocol assumption.
method: Static byte parsing, bounded LZMA-alone decode in memory and Capstone 5.0.6 AArch64. No firmware execution or device access. Parent ABL/candidate results used by reference, not re-derived here.

Outer FV SEC FFS @0x1fe8, TE section @0x2f34, TE payload @0x2f38 AArch64, ImageBase 0xc6801000, StrippedSize 0xf60. config.source: xbl_config.img, 397312 bytes; CFGL @0x200. pre-ddr.dtbs.bin [0x31c,0x1125c), post-ddr.dtbs.bin [0x1125c,0x43c9c). Parsed all 10 consecutive FDTs in these entries. Board/chip IDs below are raw property bytes, not a device identification.
config.conclusion: Exactly one case-insensitive Kernel label in the post-DDR base. None of its six packaged overlay FDTs writes this node, its ancestry or a competing label. Resolved fragment targets via fixups/base symbols and inspected actual descendant writes. The pre-DDR bundle is separate, not a fallback Kernel value. The outer uefiplat.cfg @FFS 0x55000 announces migration to DT, not a second numeric source.

SEC_trace_file_offsets: DT handoff: 10d50 calls 170e0; 17110-17178 obtains shared cookie via fixed u32 @3b060 and loads DTB pointer/length at cookie+58/+60, caches blob at 4e100. 17180-171ec checks fixed address window. Local UseDTSelectLib selector initialized zero at 17108-0c: zero path 17340-68 passes supplied blob to 21a7c, not a lookup of an on-disk xbl_config offset. Alternative selector=1 code 17204-172fc would run get_dt and replace cached pointer, not taken by the traced zero initializer. Thus preceding boot-stage selection/patching remains a boundary.

10d7c -> 14240 clears table/count at 4e060/4e068; 14264 -> 14350, allocation/zero, 14420-2c opens /soc/memorymap/ via 16e00 (16e4c-5c uses cached DTB). 14474/144d0 count/cache children. 14530-54 calls 15600(node, table+i*0x48); 1459c-a4 records count. This is a path traversal, not a global match on reg.

15614-34 calls 23378(node,NULL,index=0,address_cells=2,size_cells=2,&record[0x20],&record[0x28]); literal reg at 3d3cf, property fetched at 2340c-20. 234a4-b8 / 234e0-f8 load adjacent cell pairs, convert BE64 via 2f8e4 -> 1dff0 (1e090/1e0c0), store separate u64s. 15684-98 reads mem-label into start of same record, capacity 0x20. 156e8-fc reads build-hob into +0x30.

14710 appends /soc/registermap/ records at table+count*0x48 (148fc-14930), not a replacement Kernel record. Bank/validation processing exists (10e04->15040, 10e4c->138f0). Ordinary added bank records use count-indexed destinations (e.g. 13220-38,134bc-d8,13690-ac); in-place base/size adjust at 13d0c/13d30 requires record[+0x30]==0xa at 13bf0-13c00. Packaged Kernel build-hob is 0. No Kernel-specific resize found on traced path; not a whole-machine immutability proof.

14f94-14fb0 returns table/count from 4e060/4e068; 11880-88 requests them and 118bc-d4 passes as x0/x1 to 1f810. 1f828-840 saves args, 1f890/898 caches them at 4e8e0/4e8e8. 1f868-8ac registers ASCII UEFI Config Lib @3c61e, version 0x10002, interface @404d0 via manager+8. Interface+8 @404d8 holds preferred pointer to file 1f554.

Shared manager: 1187c -> 1b994; 1b9c4-ec publishes 8-byte pointer to 40478 with GUID @40378=bedaeabc-5e70-4d66-9733-213d072b9d04. Manager slots +8/+0x10 point to 1b794/1b88c. 1b850-86c saves named entry/version/interface, 1b8f8-974 compares registry names and returns selected pointer via output. SEC 2f7cc uses same GUID and HOB+0x18 to get manager. Distinct from the variable GUID.

Registered lookup at 1f554: 1f57c-5a4 guards table/count and caller args; 1f5b0-bc compares record start against supplied ASCII name (1db58 ASCII case fold); 1f5c0-d4 visits stride 0x48 until first equal; 1f5e0-f8 copies entire matching record to caller via 19b60 and returns zero. No match returns nonzero.
QcomBds_trace_RVAs: 5428 calls 554c. At 5600-10 x0=ASCII Kernel @18471, x1=x21=sp+0x20 (out record); bl 8b08. That wrapper on empty cache calls 8ac4. 79c4/1337c/1332c finds type-4 GUID HOB matching @1e168 (same manager GUID), loads pointer at HOB+0x18. 8ad4-8af4 calls manager+0x10 with ASCII UEFI Config Lib @193ac, version 0, &cache @1e928. 8b38-50 tailcalls cached interface+8 with original x0/x1; null cache returns error. Named library binding, not inferred EFI LocateProtocol.

5614 branches on status==0 to 5650. On lookup failure, 5618-564c checks PropagateKernelSocInfo only to condition a diagnostic; bypasses BOTH writes. No numeric substitute there. SharedIMEMBaseAddr immediately before this block and SAIL_OTA following it are separate lookups.

Runtime table established at 13c0-c8 -> 12aac-b4: [SystemTable+0x58] -> global 1e9f8. 5650-5678 loads this table then slot +0x58 (EFI SetVariable); x0=UTF16 KernelBaseAddr @17e54, x1=GUID @1e068=882f8c2b-9646-435f-8de5-f208ff80c1bd, w2=2, w3=8, x4=x21+0x20=sp+0x40. 567c-569c repeats for KernelSize @17e72, same GUID, w2=2,w3=8,x4=x21+0x28=sp+0x48. No arithmetic on field values or branch on first write status. Second status not checked here either. Attribute 2 is BOOTSERVICE_ACCESS alone, not RUNTIME_ACCESS or NV; runtime-services API does not imply post-ExitBootServices visibility.

Publication precedes later mode check at 542c-34. Separate preloaded path 5498-54cc gets address/size and looks up Kernel again, 54d4-550c checks containment against +0x20/+0x28 (assert text @18ada), 553c indirect handoff. Not an alternate SetVariable size. Only QcomBds contained literal UTF16 KernelSize among 63 parsed inner PE payloads; this limited scan does not exclude dynamic names or later writers.

conditional_values.predicate: Earlier stage supplies this post-DDR map or its covered overlays, successful parse/registration, unchanged first Kernel record, publication path reached and both writes succeed. To use as ABL inputs both matching GetVariable calls must later succeed without intervening replacement.

ABL_fit.receiver_RVAs: 120a0-12108 gets both 8-byte values; 12170-12194/12314-12384 uses successful pair. Not the fallback span.
ABL_fit.equation: Nonwrapping arithmetic, raw Image text_offset=0: require S >= H + D; D=align_up(V+R+E,P)+2*P+0x400000.
ABL_fit.init_boot: For E=0 and page-rounded R, required S=74227712+R. Max such R at this S: 194207744 bytes. For nonzero E recompute alignment; R not measured here.
